title: Perfect ordinary realization and scalar extension at an algebraically closed point
statement:
Let $p$ be prime, $k$ an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $u:A\to B$ a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings annihilated by integers prime to $p$. Use ordinary uncompleted derived categories of constant module sheaves on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let $D^b_{ctf}(s,A)$ mean bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude], with the finite-ring etale-origin convention [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin]. Write $T_s(M)=M\otimes_A^LB$ for ordinary derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and let $\Gamma_s$ be sections over the final object, applied termwise on complexes [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact]. An ordinary perfect $A$-complex means a complex isomorphic to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $A$-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex].

For every $M\in D^b_{ctf}(s,A)$, the ordinary complex $\Gamma_sM$ is perfect, and the canonical sections--tensor comparison is an isomorphism
$$S_M:(\Gamma_sM)\otimes_A^LB\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma_s(T_sM).$$
It is natural in $M$, is the identity for $u=\operatorname{id}_A$, and is compatible with composition of finite coefficient maps under the derived associativity identifications. In particular, on a bounded complex of constant sheaves associated to finite projective $A$-modules, $S_M$ is the class of the termwise map $\Gamma_s(F)\otimes_A B\to\Gamma_s(F\otimes_A B)$ sending $x\otimes b$ to the section $x\otimes b$.
